Mean T1 and T2* for four example qubits. Measured values include cooldown
scatter. Squares are a slightly lower simulation. Diamonds are the 2 T1
coherence limit. Screen keeps hover. Print is static. The page mode selects
the matching figure.

## Screen

```{python}
#| renderings: [light, dark]
from review import bars, for_renderings, show

for_renderings(lambda appearance: show(bars(), reading="screen", appearance=appearance))
```

## Print

```{python}
#| renderings: [light, dark]
for_renderings(lambda appearance: show(bars(), reading="print", appearance=appearance))
```
